# ashiba-keisan (足場強度計算スキル)

> Universal AI Agent Skill and Python structural calculation engine for Japanese scaffolding and temporary structures (SUCCES Ver 4.11 / 仮設工業会 / AIJ).
> Supports Frame Scaffolding (枠組足場), Single-Pipe One-Sided Bracket Scaffolding (単管一側ブラケット足場), Scaffold Support Cantilever Brackets (足場受ブラケット), Steel-Frame Suspended Scaffolding (鉄骨吊り足場), and Material Loading Platforms (荷取り構台).

## Core Skill & Web Prompt
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RingLord3812/ashiba-keisan/main/skills/ashiba-keisan/SKILL.md): Concise agent workflow, CLI usage, and forbidden-error checklist.
- [Standalone Web-Chat Prompt Bundle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RingLord3812/ashiba-keisan/main/dist/ashiba-keisan-web-prompt.md): Single-file knowledge pack for ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Gemini Gems, and NotebookLM.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RingLord3812/ashiba-keisan/main/AGENTS.md): Universal repository instructions for coding agents.
